_comment: Row 342. M1 restores the demonstrated wrong green by discarding git status exit 77 while its stdout remains empty. M2 misclassifies UNKNOWN as DIRTY. M3 is the lazy inversion control: it refuses a genuinely clean tree while preserving both the failed-status fix and the dirty-tree bound. Re-run from a detached scratch copy with: venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row342_git_status_unknown.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH. The companion transform-control spec applies M1 byte-for-byte to a test that only sources the library and must ESCAPE.
subject: row 342 -- a failed git status is UNKNOWN while measured clean and dirty states remain reachable
